# CircularProgressChart

## Overview

`CircularProgressChart` is a top-level compound chart that visualises multiple metrics as concentric progress rings. Each ring represents progress toward its own goal (`value / max`). Use this chart to compare several KPIs against their own targets at a glance.

It composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, optional `DataDisplay`, `CircularProgressGroup`, optional `InlineChartKeyGroup`, and `ChartFooter` via the **Organized Props Pattern** (two layers: Parent Props, Child Configs). All design tokens are resolved via the CSS cascade — no runtime JS token resolver, no `modes` prop.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `977:148753`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=977-148753

## Architecture

```
CircularProgressChart
└── ChartAccessibility (role="figure", summary, data table, aria-live)
    ├── ChartHeader (title + subtitle)
    ├── ChartLegend (auto-generated from data, up to 6 items)
    ├── DataDisplay (optional summary block)
    ├── CircularProgressGroup (concentric progress rings)
    │   ├── path.pathTrack × N (decorative background)
    │   ├── path.progress × N (interactive, keyboard-navigable)
    │   └── Badge (optional, cursor-following hover badge)
    ├── InlineChartKeyGroup (optional detailed legend with values)
    └── ChartFooter (source + notes)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { CircularProgressChart } from "./charts/CircularProgressChart";
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```typescript
import { CircularProgressDataPoint } from "./charts/CircularProgressChart";

const data: CircularProgressDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "Revenue", value: 72 },
  { category: "Users",   value: 48 },
  { category: "Sessions", value: 35 },
];
```

`CircularProgressDataPoint` extends `ChartDataPoint` with an optional per-ring `max`:

```typescript
interface CircularProgressDataPoint extends ChartDataPoint {
  max?: number;
}
```

### Per-Ring Max

```typescript
const data: CircularProgressDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "Steps", value: 7820, max: 10000 },
  { category: "Active minutes", value: 42, max: 60 },
  { category: "Calories", value: 1620, max: 2200 },
];
```

Each ring scales against its own `max`. When `max` is omitted, the chart-level `max` prop is used (default `100`).

### Ring Order

By default, `data[0]` renders as the **outermost** ring. Set `circularProgressGroupConfig.ringOrder` to `"inner-first"` to flip this — useful when the most important metric should be the focal point in the centre. Legend order always reflects source-data order, independent of ring order.

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface CircularProgressChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent component props
  data: CircularProgressDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  max?: number;
  chartHeader?: boolean;
  chartLegend?: boolean;
  dataDisplay?: boolean;
  inlineChartKeyGroup?: boolean;
  chartFooter?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;
  animated?: boolean;

  // Layer 3: Child component configurations
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: CircularProgressDataDisplayConfig;
  circularProgressGroupConfig?: CircularProgressGroupConfig;
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig?: InlineChartKeyGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={[
    { category: "Revenue", value: 72 },
    { category: "Users",   value: 48 },
    { category: "Sessions", value: 35 },
  ]}
  max={100}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Quarterly Targets",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Progress toward quarterly goals",
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay Summary

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: "Total progress",
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: "2,390", dataSupportingValue: "/ 3,000" },
    badgeConfig: { value: "+2.34" },
    supportingBadgeLabelValue: "Than last month.",
  }}
/>
```

### Per-Ring Max

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={[
    { category: "Steps", value: 7820, max: 10000 },
    { category: "Active minutes", value: 42, max: 60 },
    { category: "Calories", value: 1620, max: 2200 },
  ]}
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    secondaryMode: "max",
    formatValue: (v) => v.toLocaleString(),
    formatMax: (m) => `/ ${m.toLocaleString()}`,
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  data={data}
  width={432}
  max={100}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  chartFooter
  interactive
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Property    | CSS Token                           | Fallback       | Purpose                                            |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Section gap | `--CircularProgressChart-gap`       | `--Spacing-5`  | Gap between chart sections (header, legend, rings) |
| Ring 1–12   | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1–12}` | extended CSS   | Per-ring progress colour via DataVis pipeline      |
| Track fill  | `--Neutral-Minimal`                 | CSS cascade    | Decorative track behind each progress arc          |
| Pill radius | `--Shape-Pill`                      | `9999px`       | End-cap corner radius                              |
| Arc width   | `--Spacing-{2–8}`                   | `20px`         | T-shirt size to px mapping for arc thickness       |

All DataVis categorical tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) are injected at `@layer brand` by `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` from Convex palette data. Surface / typography tokens (`--Neutral-Minimal`, `--Shape-Pill`, `--Spacing-*`) are injected by the brand CSS engine via `useBrandCSSNew`.

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend` is `true` and `chartLegendConfig.items` is not provided:

- One legend item per data point (up to 6), using `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)` through `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-6)`
- Custom `data[i].color` overrides the categorical token for that ring

Legend order always reflects source-data order, independent of `ringOrder`.

## InlineChartKeyGroup Auto-Generation

When `inlineChartKeyGroup` is `true` and `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig.data` is not provided, rows are generated from the chart data. Each row displays:

- Shape indicator + category label
- Formatted main value (`formatValue`)
- Optional secondary slot: `"/ max"` or `"percentage %"` depending on `secondaryMode`

## Responsive Sizing

The ring area is a flex child of the chart with `aspect-ratio: 1 / 1` as its preferred natural size, capped by `max-height: 100%` + `min-height: 0`. This lets the chart drop into a CSS grid cell, a flex column, or any other fixed-height container and honour the available space without bleeding into neighbouring cells. Three behaviours follow from this:

- **No explicit `height` prop**: the ring wrapper grows to a square sized by `width`, and the chart's intrinsic height is `header + legend + dataDisplay + width² + inlineKey + footer`.
- **Explicit `height` shorter than the natural square**: the ring wrapper shrinks to the remaining space after the siblings. `CircularProgressGroup` measures the wrapper via `ResizeObserver` and picks `Math.min(width, height)` as the drawing square, so the rings stay circular at the largest size that fits.
- **Sibling heights change at runtime**: the same `ResizeObserver` path runs. Outside of an animation this rescales the rings in place (snap). Inside a data-change animation it piggybacks onto the in-flight tween so the radii transition smoothly alongside the sweep.

## Hover Interaction

### Dimming Behavior

| State                               | Opacity | Description               |
| ----------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| **Default** (nothing hovered)       | `1`     | All rings at full opacity |
| **Highlighted** (this ring hovered) | `1`     | Stays vibrant             |
| **Dimmed** (another ring hovered)   | `0.4`   | Non-active rings fade     |

### Hit Area Overlay

Each interactive ring is hover/click/focusable across the **full 360° annular slot**, not just the filled portion of the arc. A transparent overlay `<path>` sized by `circularProgressGroupConfig.hitAreaArcWidth` owns all mouse + keyboard + ARIA events.

### Hover Callbacks

Pass callbacks via `circularProgressGroupConfig`:

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  circularProgressGroupConfig={{
    onRingHover: (ring) => console.log(ring),
    onRingClick: (ring) => setSelected(ring),
  }}
  ...
/>
```

`RingHoverData` contains `{ isHovered, index, category, value, max, percentage, color, mouseX?, mouseY? }`.

### Controlled Hover

Pass `hoveredRingIndex` to sync hover state with external UI (e.g. a data table row).

## Hover Badge

Set `circularProgressGroupConfig.hoverBadge: true` to show a cursor-following badge.

```tsx
<CircularProgressChart
  circularProgressGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverBadgeConfig: {
      formatValue: (value, category, percentage) =>
        `${category}: ${value} (${percentage?.toFixed(0)}%)`,
    },
  }}
  ...
/>
```

## Animation

Set `animated: true` to enable two independent rAF-driven loops — one for mount-time entry and a second for data-change transitions — both sourcing every timing value from CSS motion tokens (no hardcoded values).

**Entry** (first render only):

- **Progress arc**: each ring sweeps from 0 to its target progress, staggered by `--Motion-Offset-M` and eased through `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate` over `--Motion-Duration-L`.
- **Track fade-in** (when `showTrack=true`): each ring's track fades `opacity: 0 → 1` on the same stagger slot as the arc.

**Data change** (post-entry, `--Motion-Easing-Transition-Moderate`, `--Motion-Duration-M`, **no stagger**):

- **Continuing rings**: `endAngle`, `opacity`, and inner/outer radii all interpolate concurrently.
- **New rings**: fade + sweep concurrently (`opacity: 0 → 1` AND `endAngle: startAngle → target`).
- **Removed rings**: fade `opacity: 1 → 0`, then unmounted on completion.
- **Reappearing rings**: tween resumes mid-flight using current DOM opacity as start state.

When `animated=false`, both loops are skipped — every change resolves to its final state on the next render.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` and wired up via `useChartAccessibility`. Enabled by default.

- `role="figure"` with `aria-label`, `aria-describedby`
- Auto-generated natural language summary
- Visually-hidden `<table>` for screen reader data navigation (Category, Value, Max, Percent columns)
- `aria-live="polite"` region for hover/focus announcements (debounced via `useAriaLiveRegion`)
- Roving tab index keyboard navigation (Up/Down arrows, Home, End, Enter, Space) when `interactive`
- `aria-controls` wired to DataDisplay only when `dataDisplay: true`

See **[ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md)** for full configuration.

## Performance Notes

- `catColor` is a stable `useCallback` returning CSS var strings — no JS token resolution at render time
- `resolvedLegendItems` and `resolvedInlineChartKeyGroupData` are memoized separately, each with a minimal dep array
- `CircularProgressGroup` handles all D3 geometry with its own memoisation
- Entry + data-change animations share a single `requestAnimationFrame` loop
- Container gap resolved entirely in CSS (`var(--CircularProgressChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))`) — no inline pixel values
